observation: Builder src/render/opticCellPresentation.js. Stone variant 1 keeps the shared displaced common-rock geometry ast:geology-v5:ast_common_rock:1 (visualFactory.js:2259-2261, reached via the null return at opticCellPresentation.js:122-126) and the cached 'optic:body:stone:v1' material (132-160, 248-256). ROCK_SURFACE_VARIANTS[1] is the cool dusty matte row — tint [0.70,0.72,0.74], roughness 1.06, ao 0.86, normalScale 0.62 (rockSurfaceLibrary.js:22) — so variant 1's distinct look costs one material and zero extra geometry/texture clones. The cache key includes a ':bare' suffix when the rock surface library has not decoded yet (254) so pre-decode cells can swap to the mapped material later without rebuilding (syncOpticCellSkin 438-451); that bounded bare entry is a deliberate save-restore path, not a leak. No prism inclusions, no per-cell material or geometry allocation (module header 40-54). The runtime variant is hashId(entity.id)%5 (visualFactory.js:2642), so this ledger variant corresponds to the hash bucket rather than a hard-coded placement.
decision: No construction change recommended; variant 1 shares the pool geometry and differs only by its intentional per-variant surface material. Recommend needs follow-up on visual evidence.
next: Needs a current capture at gameplay scale and close showing variant 1's cooler dusty response beside the other stone variants; source inspection is not visual acceptance.
